models.name: Synthetic IOP estimation stack v0.3.0
models.purpose: software engineering of IOP estimation, quality gating and uncertainty on synthetic acquisitions; not IOP measurement

models.input: 10 kHz pressure and optical channels, 320 samples, calibration/alignment metadata; feature set iop-features-1
models.bundle_storage: regenerated by scripts/train_iop_model.py --profile full; not stored in Git
models.status: synthetic held-out evaluation only; see generated card
